metadata.author: Jaden Cole
metadata.title: Dental Blockers Export — Escalated
metadata.demo_effect: Introduces active blockers that should populate the Data tab and lower health confidence.

payload.summary: The blocker export highlights two active issues for the dental product: an unsigned vendor contract and pending test environment access. Both issues are critical and require immediate attention to avoid delays in project planning and execution.

decisions.label: require decision from acquisition/legal path
decisions.anchorText: Decision required from acquisition/legal path by 4/15.

warnings: The vendor contract remains unsigned, which blocks final sandbox commitment and Sprint 3 planning.
Named users still cannot access the vendor environment, and mitigation options are under review.
